title: api-gateway error-rate SLO burn
description: SLO burn-rate alert: error budget burn on api-gateway; 2.0% of requests failing at peak and some requests timing out.
root_cause_detail: A dependency upgrade shipped in orders-api v4.18.1 leaked buffers on every request.
expected_symptoms: orders-api memory_usage climbs gradually from ~49% to ~97% over ~64+ minutes
increasing GC / heap pressure logs on orders-api
orders-api p95 latency rises from ~145ms to ~903ms as memory grows
orders-api errors appear late, error rate up to ~5.4%
orders-api db_connection_utilization stays within normal range
deployment of orders-api v4.18.1 shortly before memory growth starts
resolution: Rolled back orders-api to v4.18.0 and pinned the library version.
